value.rationale: Jordan type is a canonical invariant of multiplication on local Artinian algebras; a complete exact probability/multiplicity profile for every element across all \(n,q,p\) is a natural nontrivial classification. The formula captures nonlinear strata (at \(n=3\) in characteristic \(3\), partition \((3,2,1)\) is impossible for linear forms), and a sharp modular transition at \(p\mid n\). This is more substantial than counting one arbitrary slice or restating a textbook identity.
